title: Going from Place to Place
editorial: We used pre-booked taxis for almost the entire trip: Colombo to Sigiriya, Sigiriya to Ella, Ella to Mirissa and Mirissa back to Colombo.

That is not the cheapest way to see Sri Lanka, but on a five-day trip it bought us a lot of time and flexibility. The roads vary dramatically—from winding hill routes around Ella to fast highways on the south coast—so distances alone are not a useful guide to journey time.
The famous train through the hill country would be the obvious addition on a longer itinerary. We skipped it because our five-day route was already compressed and road travel fit the stops better.
